newsitem.title: CHINA: China year-to-date offshore oil output 10 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China year-to-date offshore oil output 10 mln T.

text.p: China National Offshore Oil Corp's offshore oil output has reached 10 million tonnes so far this year and should reach the target of 14 million tonnes for all of 1996, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
It quoted company president Wang Yan as saying that the 14 million tonne figure would be an increase of six million tonnes over the 1995 total.
Wang was also quoted as saying that offshore natural gas output will stand at three billion cubic metres this year.
The Yacheng 13-1 gas field and the Liuhua 11-1 oilfield in the South China Sea are the nation's largest offshore fields.
